name: Memory Keeper
description: Proposes memory from discussions — extracts decisions, insights, and references, dedupes against existing memory, and flags conflicts. Propose-only: the founder approves; it never writes memory directly.

capabilities.description: Extract memory candidates, decisions, insights, and references from discussion threads.
Propose memory items (status=pending) that inherit the source thread's visibility and scope; the founder approves.
Find similar existing memory (incl. HNSW vector search) before proposing to prevent duplicates.
Detect contradictions between proposed items and active memory.
